10578|a23e2e4e.name: Bom'bay
10578|a23e2e4e.text: Heya mon.  Go talk to mah Master Gadrin right over there.  Take care of that Zalazane crazy for him and I fix ya right up!

266881|932ae4f0.name: Pa'zula
266881|932ae4f0.text: What business do you have in the Echo Isles, $c?

3142|99ae9589.name: Orgnil Soulscar
3142|99ae9589.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

3188|366172e1.name: Master Gadrin
3188|366172e1.text: There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.

3191|0c543544.name: Cook Torka
3191|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

7953|a3eec9a8.name: Xar'Ti
7953|a3eec9a8.text: You need to be exalted with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

806-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
806-accept.text:
We cannot allow the Burning Blade a foothold in Durotar!  We must destroy them before their evil festers!

I have undergone my own investigations and found that a Burning Blade warlock, the goblin Fizzle Darkstorm, has camped within Thunder Ridge to the northwest.  There he and his cultist minions spread chaos.

Find and defeat Fizzle, and bring me his dead claw!
806-accept.title: Dark Storms

808-complete.name: Master Gadrin
808-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  You have saved Minshina.  You have saved my brother's spirit from slavery!
808-complete.title: Minshina's Skull

808-progress.name: Master Gadrin
808-progress.text: Do you have my brother's skull, $N?  Is he finally free?
808-progress.title: Minshina's Skull

815-complete.name: Cook Torka
815-complete.text:
You might be weak, but at least you're not clumsy, $N.

Here, take this and get outta my way. I've got cooking to do.
815-complete.title: Break a Few Eggs

815-progress.name: Cook Torka
815-progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
815-progress.title: Break a Few Eggs

817-complete.name: Vel'rin Fang
817-complete.text:
I am pleased, $N. Because of your help, our people will be protected, and not go cold as the seasons change.

Thank you.
817-complete.title: Practical Prey

817-progress.name: Vel'rin Fang
817-progress.text:
I remember my first tiger hunt, $N. I chose to hunt on the largest of the Echo Isles, and I sat perfectly still in the shadows of its foliage for almost a full day... watching... waiting.

My muscles were taut, and I was ready to strike. It was one of my greatest victories when that tiger finally took the bait.
817-progress.title: Practical Prey

818-complete.name: Master Vornal
818-complete.text: Well done, young one... well done indeed.
818-complete.title: A Solvent Spirit

818-progress.name: Master Vornal
818-progress.text: Time is the true test of your strength and will. Lose patience or give in to weakness, and your true self will be shown.
818-progress.title: A Solvent Spirit

823-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
823-complete.text: Yes?  You have something to report?  Well then, let's have it!
823-complete.title: Report to Orgnil

826-complete.name: Master Gadrin
826-complete.text:
With Zalazane gone, our tribe can again sleep in peace.

Thank you, $N.  The Darkspear tribe owes you much.  If you suffer from an ailment, visit my assistant Bom'bay, behind me.  His voodoo is strong...
826-complete.title: Zalazane

96873-complete.name: Pa'zula
96873-complete.text: Fine work. A shame about the slain trolls, but with the binding spells removed, their spirits can rest.
96873-complete.title: A Pain in the Neck

96873-progress.name: Pa'zula
96873-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?
96873-progress.title: A Pain in the Neck

97223-complete.name: Xar'Ti
97223-complete.text: Thank you, $N. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.
97223-complete.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97223-progress.name: Xar'Ti
97223-progress.text:
The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.

Unfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.

Still I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.
97223-progress.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

99048-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99048-accept.text:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
99048-accept.title: A Missing Hand

99048-complete.name: Heglan Shadeeye
99048-complete.text:
Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.

Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.
99048-complete.title: A Missing Hand

99049-accept.name: Heglan Shadeeye
99049-accept.text:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
99049-accept.title: Threat from Below
